checks.detail: 20.0% needed > 8% minimum for A6063-T5: bend in a softer temper (e.g. O or T4, then age) or raise CLR to >= 100 mm
checks.source: Pines/Unison: elongation = (OD/2)/CLR; JIS G 3445 Table 3 note a), JIS G 3459 clause 6.1

checks.detail: extrados wall 0.83 mm (16.7% thinner); ovality without a mandrel about 4.5% (typical acceptance 5-8%), lower with one
checks.source: Bend Tooling thinning rule; Tube Form Solutions: ovality = 0.7 x difficulty factor
